_comment: USB IDs of consumer structured-light 3D scanners, for naming them when plugged in. Omit productId (or set it to "*") to match every product from a vendor; an entry naming the exact product wins over a vendor-wide one. Entries with "enabled": false are ignored. Vendor 2207 is Rockchip's, the chip maker's: Revopoint and Einstar scanners both use it.
